snippet.title: Below The Stone | Version 1.0 | Launching November 17th
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: ► http://apo.gg/BelowTheStone
The deepest descent begins November 17! After years in Early Access, Below The Stone, the Dwarven Extraction Roguelike from Strollart and Apogee Entertainment, officially launches into Version 1.0 on PC via Steam, GOG, and the Epic Games Store!

Descend into dangerous, procedurally generated caverns, battle deadly creatures, mine precious resources, and complete quests to bring valuable loot back to your Dwarven Kingdom.

But beware! Every expedition is a gamble. Fall in battle, and you risk losing everything you've carried underground.

Version 1.0 brings:
💎 Layer 3: Descend into the deepest layer yet, featuring 9 new biomes and 27 biomes in total!
⚔️ New Bosses & Enemies: Face terrifying new threats lurking beneath the stone.
🪄 Magic Weapons & Equipment: Discover powerful new ways to battle the creatures below.
🛡️ New Armor Sets: Craft 9 new Layer 3 armor sets, experiment with set bonuses, and customize your playstyle.
🏰 Expanded Kingdom: Complete new NPC quests, unlock upgrades, and meet the new Magic Crafter.
✨ More to Discover: New dungeons, accessories, resources, dynamic lighting, achievements, and more! Dig deep. Fight hard. Get rich. Make it home alive.

Below The Stone Version 1.0 launches November 17 for $14.99, with a 20% launch discount!
